title: Exact completed realization and its normalized derived cohomology comparisons
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $(A,I)$ an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], in particular $A$ is commutative Noetherian. On the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] write $B_T=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}\underline{A/I^n}$, where $\underline M$ denotes the sheafification of the constant module presheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $A_T=\varprojlim_n(A/I^n)_T$ be the completed coefficient sheaf of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and $\gamma:B_T\xrightarrow{\sim}A_T$ the normalized completed coefficient isomorphism used in [def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models], induced levelwise by the sheafified constant-function maps $\underline{A/I^n}\to(A/I^n)_T$. Let $F_T:\operatorname{Mod}(A)\to\operatorname{Mod}(A_T)$ be $M\mapsto B_T\otimes_{\underline A}\underline M$, regarded as an $A_T$-module by restriction of scalars along $\gamma^{-1}$; this is the realization of that definition. Then $F_T$ is additive and exact. Its termwise action descends to an exact functor $DF_T:D(A)\to D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. There are isomorphisms, natural in $P\in D(A)$ and $M\in\operatorname{Mod}(A)$,
$$F_T(H^q(P))\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(DF_T(P)),\qquad DF_T(M[r])\xrightarrow{\sim}F_T(M)[r]\quad(q,r\in\mathbf Z),$$
where $M[r]$ is the shift of the degree-zero complex. The comparisons are the ones induced by preservation of kernels, images and cokernels on complexes, and by the localization factorization of the termwise functor, followed by exact restriction along the normalized coefficient-ring isomorphism. They hold for unbounded $P$ and arbitrary $M$.

source.place: Tags 093J (lemma-constant-exact), 093M (lemma-completion-flat); derived.tex, Tag 015F (lemma-right-derived-exact-functor). Applied to Bhatt–Scholze Proposition 6.6.11 and Proposition 6.8.11(3); normalized realization is the one in the existing DAG definition.

proof.text: Use integralConstantModule_exact and integralConstantModule_additive from the existing realization module [def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models]. They give preservation of finite limits and finite colimits, and additivity, for exactly the normalized functor F_T. These results already incorporate constant sheafification, flat scalar extension and restriction along the normalized completed coefficient comparison. No new exactness argument is required here.

Install these exactness instances and HasDerivedCategory.standard for ModuleCat A. By definition integralConstantDerived is F_T.mapDerivedCategory. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]: its existing Mathlib instances give the triangulated structure and shift compatibility of mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom. The defined integralRealizationFactors is precisely that factorization. Together with step 1 these prove integralConstantRealization_exact_derived.

Retain the actual natural isomorphisms constructed in the module. integralRealizationHomologyIso is mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso: it descends the inverse complex homology comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] through [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property] and the factorization of step 2. integralRealizationShiftedModuleIso composes the canonical derived shift isomorphism with mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor at zero. These use the same exact functor F_T and therefore the same coefficient transport. All constructions apply to unbounded derived objects and arbitrary modules.
